jobs.description:
Night Receptionist @ Via Amsterdam
Via Amsterdam is more than just a youth hotel— it's a vibrant, multi-functional playground for curious, new-age travellers. And at the heart of it all? The reception. As our Night Receptionist, you're not just a team member — you're the soul of the night shift 💖.You're the first friendly face guests see when they arrive and the one who ensures their Amsterdam adventure kicks off right. Forget the boring, “passport and booking number please” routine — we're all about real connection. Whether it's sharing your favourite hidden vintage shop, that cozy café around the corner, or the coffee shop everyone's actually here for, you're the go-to local insider.During the night, you and your shift buddy (or buddies) are responsible for the entire hostel. With nearly 1,000 beds filled, that's no small task — but don't worry, we've got your back. You'll receive thorough on-the-job training and complete an official Emergency Response Officer (BHV) course — a one-day session, right here at our location. We're looking for someone who combines that training with good judgment and common sense to keep Via both safe and fun.A workday includes:
• Being the first smiling face guests see (even at 2 AM!).
• Checking guests in and out, answering calls, and helping with questions.
• Giving the lowdown on Amsterdam's must-sees, hidden gems, and can't-miss experiences.
• Doing security rounds, handling issues, and making detailed reports.
• Keeping tabs on stock and restocking as needed.
• Wrapping up front office admin tasks like the night audit.
• Keeping the lobby looking sharp and welcoming.

Experience in shipbuilding, yacht building, marine engineering, offshore, naval design or complex technical engineering. Experience with software such as AutoCAD, Rhino, Siemens NX, SolidWorks, Inventor, Maxsurf, NAPA, ShipConstructor, Cadmatic or similar tools is relevant. Knowledge of stability, structures, weight control, hull design, outfitting or classification rules is a strong advantage.
